explanation: Ali loses his sister's only shoes, so they swap one pair between school shifts. It became the first Iranian film nominated for the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film.

claims.text: In Children of Heaven (1997), a brother and sister secretly share a single pair of shoes.
The siblings do not share a bicycle, a school uniform or a goldfish; a goldfish features in a different Iranian film, The White Balloon.
Ali loses his sister's only pair of shoes, and they take turns wearing his between their school shifts.
Children of Heaven was the first Iranian film nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.
